tasks.short: Provide environmental scientific guidance and technical coordination

steps.what: Read the actual environmental question, measurements, program documents and relevant technical evidence
inputs: actual request and site/program context
actual measurement and technical-source records

steps.what: Provide scientific guidance, support and coordination through actual discussion of the issue and responsible next actions
inputs: scientist-checked issue evidence and gaps
actual recipient questions and responsibilities
outputs: scientist's explained guidance and actual clarification needs
steps.handoff_to: agency, program, industry or public recipient

steps.what: Complete and check the actual written scientific guidance, evidence limitations and intended recipient
inputs: scientist's explained guidance and actual clarification needs
scientist-checked issue evidence and gaps
outputs: complete checked technical guidance and recipient

steps.what: Send the completed checked scientific guidance to the intended external recipient
inputs: complete checked technical guidance and recipient
steps.handoff_to: agency, program, industry or public recipient

tasks.design: Configure native evidence links in {DOCS} and {OTHER}, the environmental records application, with fixed source-reference fields in the actual guidance format. The scientist interprets the evidence, discusses the issue and writes/checks the guidance before its separate {EMAIL} send; no technical conclusion is generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated evidence navigation and source-reference entry can interrupt technical support.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record links and reusable reference fields can carry actual source identities.
tasks.still_hard: The appropriate response depends on uncertain evidence and recipient responsibilities.
tasks.human_edge: Explain what the evidence cannot establish and coordinate a defensible next action.

ambition.what: No automatic oversight decision or public scientific statement.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for actual environmental records and recipient permissions

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native evidence links can reduce handling while contextual environmental scientific guidance remains expert work.

assumptions: Shares describe an unmeasured technical-support exchange that actually includes written guidance, not a report invented after every discussion.
Requesters provide actual questions/context; laboratory and program owners provide actual evidence. The scientist investigates missing information within s1.
Only source navigation/reference transfer changes. No free structured issue log, automatic advice or extra notification is assumed; equivalent current links remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 4.2 minus 1 hour of reference upkeep gives 3.2 net. The final send is negligible and fully retained.
The final message and recipient are checked during ordinary writing in s3; any edit invalidates the gate.
unknowns: Actual written-guidance frequency and evidence navigation
research_questions: Do actual support exchanges repeat evidence/reference handling beyond native tools?

already_counted.description: Read evidence and complete/check actual guidance

incremental.description: Maintain evidence links and guidance reference fields

approvals.approved_version: complete checked technical guidance and recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 3.2%; scientific interpretation and conversation remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Process and review environmental permits and licenses

steps.what: Check the actual environmental permit/license application, document versions and required submission items in the permit case system
inputs: actual submitted permit/license application and attachments
current agency-maintained item checklist
outputs: checked application inventory and missing-item findings

steps.what: Read application evidence against the applicable actual permit requirements and prepare source-linked review findings
inputs: checked application inventory and missing-item findings
actual application text and agency-selected applicable requirement versions
outputs: draft source-linked environmental permit review findings

loop.purpose: Propose application passages relevant to the scientist-selected permit requirements
loop.input: actual application passages and exact applicable requirement versions selected by scientist
loop.output: draft passage-to-requirement references with explicit gaps
loop.check: Scientist opens each cited passage and requirement, checks meaning and completeness and decides the finding
loop.stop: Missing page, ambiguous applicability, unsupported claim or conflicting version returns to manual review
loop.why_not_simpler: Presence checks cannot interpret relevance of narrative environmental evidence

steps.what: Resolve scientific and applicability issues and complete the checked permit/license review record and proposed case status
inputs: draft source-linked environmental permit review findings
actual application evidence and applicable requirements
outputs: complete checked permit review record and proposed case status

steps.what: Save the completed checked permit/license review record and authorised case status in the existing permit case system
inputs: complete checked permit review record and proposed case status

tasks.design: Use native completeness/version checks in {OTHER}, the permit case application, before a bounded passage-finding aid in {DOCS}. The scientist selects actual applicable requirements, verifies every proposed reference and completes the review/status before saving; the aid neither grants a permit nor sends an applicant decision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative evidence takes time to locate even after deterministic completeness checks.
tasks.enabler_now: A bounded source-passage aid can propose relevant evidence without determining compliance.
tasks.still_hard: Applicability, conflicting evidence and sufficient environmental protection require authorised judgment.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when an apparently complete submission does not establish compliance.

ambition.what: No autonomous permit decision or statutory interpretation.

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-8 for case access, document processing and authorised reviewer consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native completeness checks and bounded passage retrieval can assist permit review while applicability and findings require professional verification.

assumptions: Shares are provisional human permit-review effort, not measured case times.

Applicants produce actual files; case staff maintain identifiers/version inventory; the agency maintains the checklist. Scientist selection of applicable requirements and any manual text capture remain in s1/s2/s3.
Native item checks first. Missing or scanned unreadable content requires manual handling, not an invented structured application feed; all substantive review remains counted.
Gross provisional saving 10.25 minus 2 hours of checklist/source-aid upkeep gives 8.25 net. Same-system save is negligible and fully retained.
This is the scientist's review/status within existing authority, not final permit issuance. Any separate official decision or applicant send needs its own existing responsible process.
unknowns: Application text quality and current native completeness tools
research_questions: Does passage assistance save review effort after full citation and applicability checks?

already_counted.description: Inspect completeness and proposed evidence, resolve findings and finish the record

incremental.description: Maintain requirement versions, completeness checks and source-aid failure cases

approvals.approved_version: complete checked permit review record and proposed case status

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 8.25%; applicability, source validation and final record work remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct environmental audits, inspections and violation investigations

steps.what: Review actual audit/inspection scope, prior records and applicable inspection criteria
inputs: actual site/case and inspection scope
actual prior records and authorised criteria

steps.what: Conduct the actual environmental inspection, audit observations, sampling and investigative questioning
inputs: scientist-checked inspection context
actual site conditions, people and sampling equipment
outputs: actual observed conditions, measurements and statements

steps.what: Record and check actual observations, sample references and investigative findings in the inspection record
inputs: actual observed conditions, measurements and statements
actual site/sample identities and source evidence

steps.what: Save the completed checked environmental inspection record/findings in the existing inspection system
inputs: complete checked environmental inspection record/findings

tasks.design: Configure native prior-case links and fixed site/sample reference fields in {OTHER}, the environmental inspection application. The scientist conducts the actual inspection and writes/checks the findings before saving; no observations, violation conclusions or enforcement notices are generated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated prior-case navigation and fixed identity entry can interrupt inspection work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case links and reference fields reuse actual existing identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Actual conditions, evidential sufficiency and contradictory accounts require investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Notice a site condition that the checklist did not anticipate.

ambition.what: No automatic violation determination or enforcement.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native case links and identifier fields can reduce handling while environmental field investigation and findings remain human work.

assumptions: Shares are an unmeasured inspection including its actual record; the write is separate from fieldwork.
Case owners provide actual site/history identifiers; the scientist obtains observations and sample references in s2 and captures/checks them in s3. No structured observation feed is assumed.
Only navigation and fixed identifiers change. Actual narrative, evidence assessment and sample capture remain retained; equivalent current fields remove the gain.
Gross provisional saving 2.2 minus 0.75 hour of field/link upkeep gives 1.45 net. Save is negligible and fully retained.
No separate report or notice is added to this inspection-record scenario; any actual enforcement action remains an existing authorised process.
unknowns: Existing inspection forms and duplicated identity entry
research_questions: Do actual inspection records repeat source navigation or fixed identity entry?

already_counted.description: Read actual inspection context and complete/check findings

incremental.description: Maintain inspection reference fields and prior-case links

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 1.45%; fieldwork and substantive finding entry remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise on environmental standards, regulations and management policy

steps.what: Read actual standards/regulations and relevant environmental-policy evidence for the specific advice question
inputs: actual policy/standards question and jurisdiction
actual authoritative source versions and environmental context

steps.what: Evaluate proper application of standards/regulations or policy/code options and discuss advice with the actual recipient
inputs: scientist-checked sources and applicability limits
actual recipient constraints and policy objectives
outputs: scientist's environmental management advice and clarified recipient needs

steps.what: Complete and check the actual written environmental management advice with precise source versions, limitations and recipient
inputs: scientist's environmental management advice and clarified recipient needs
scientist-checked sources and applicability limits
outputs: complete checked environmental management advice and recipient

steps.what: Send the completed checked environmental management advice to the intended external recipient
inputs: complete checked environmental management advice and recipient

tasks.design: Configure native authoritative-source/version links in {OTHER}, the standards/reference application, and fixed reference fields in {DOCS}. The scientist determines applicability and policy advice, writes/checks the real response and separately sends it through {EMAIL}; the task's automate label does not justify automating interpretation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated source navigation and exact version entry can interrupt advice preparation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links can reuse actual document identity without generating an interpretation.
tasks.still_hard: Proper standards application and policy trade-offs depend on the actual jurisdiction and circumstances.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when an apparently relevant rule does not answer the recipient's situation.

ambition.what: No automatic policy adoption or regulatory determination.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-5 for authoritative-source access and advice responsibility consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native authoritative-source links can reduce reference handling while environmental regulatory applicability and policy advice require professional assessment.

assumptions: Shares describe unmeasured actual written-advice work, not a legal baseline or a report required after every call.
Standards/regulatory publishers supply actual source text and versions; the recipient supplies actual context. The scientist checks jurisdiction and currency in s1 and develops advice in s2.
No current legal proposition is asserted here; actual deployment must use the responsible organisation's authoritative sources. No new structured applicability input is assumed.
Only source navigation and fixed reference fields change; current equivalent tools remove the gain. Gross provisional saving 4.7 minus 1 hour of reference upkeep gives 3.7 net.
The final advice and recipient are checked during writing in s3. The negligible send is fully retained; any edit invalidates the gate.
unknowns: Actual advice outputs and authoritative-source tools
research_questions: Does real advice repeat reference handling beyond existing standards tools?

already_counted.description: Read authoritative sources and complete/check written advice

approvals.approved_version: complete checked environmental management advice and recipient

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 3.7%; scientific/regulatory applicability and substantive advice remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Verify source versions and permit evidence
role.ambitious_version: Reduce repeated evidence handling while retaining scientific guidance, permit judgment and environmental investigation.
